choice_data_list: I'm glad I managed to get yours too.
I'm glad I was able to get yours too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Huh...? You got some for me too?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's why there's so much... Just 
enough for my little sisters would've been 
fine, though—
choice_data_list: Because you said it was cute earlier.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oops, looks like I said my inner thoughts 
out loud.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Honestly, I'm super happy. Thank 
you so much!
